name: Check Summer Weather in Spain
description: Step-by-step guide to check detailed summer weather information for Spain using reliable weather services
instructions: Open Chrome browser
Click the plus (+) icon at the top of the browser window next to the rightmost tab to open a new tab
Click on the address bar
Type https://www.accuweather.com and press Enter
Wait for page to fully load until the AccuWeather logo appears in the top left
Look for the large white search bar in the center of the page with placeholder text 'Search your Address, City or Zip Code'
Click on the large white search bar in the center of the page
Clear any existing text in the search bar by clicking the X button if visible
Type Spain (uppercase S, lowercase pain) without quotes or special characters
Wait until dropdown results appear showing location options
Look for the first result that shows only 'Spain' at the top of the dropdown list
Note: Do not select options like 'Spain, SD US' or 'Spain, GA US' or any city in Spain
Wait for the Spain weather page to fully load with current conditions displayed
Look for horizontal navigation tabs with options like TODAY, HOURLY, DAILY, and MONTHLY
Locate and click on the tab labeled 'MONTHLY' (all caps)
Wait for the monthly calendar view to fully load
Look for month selection dropdown or text showing the current month name (visible as 'March' in a dropdown near the top left of the calendar)
Click on the month name dropdown (shows 'March' with a down arrow)
Wait for month selection options to appear
Find and click on 'June' from the dropdown options
If June is not available in the dropdown, look for navigation arrows near the month name
Click the right arrow next to the month name to navigate to the next month
Repeat clicking the right arrow until June is displayed
When June calendar is displayed, look for temperature data displayed within the calendar days
Note the high and low temperatures in Celsius for each day in June
Click on the month name dropdown (shows 'June' with a down arrow)
Wait for month selection options to appear
Find and click on 'July' from the dropdown options
If July is not available in the dropdown, look for navigation arrows near the month name
Click the right arrow next to the month name to navigate to the next month
Repeat clicking the right arrow until July is displayed
When July calendar is displayed, look for temperature data displayed within the calendar days
Note the high and low temperatures in Celsius for each day in July
Click on the month name dropdown (shows 'July' with a down arrow)
Wait for month selection options to appear
Find and click on 'August' from the dropdown options
If August is not available in the dropdown, look for navigation arrows near the month name
Click the right arrow next to the month name to navigate to the next month
Repeat clicking the right arrow until August is displayed
When August calendar is displayed, look for temperature data displayed within the calendar days
Note the high and low temperatures in Celsius for each day in August
Review and note historical summer temperatures
